x: Our congratulations go to Harold Whitlock upon his exceptionally fine walking, and to J. Hopkins, who made sure of a place in the Olympic team.
Whitlock was disqualified, and J. Hopkins, of Lancashire W.C., led, followed by our Fred Bentley.
Fortunately the gap is now filled with the publication of "Race Walking" by Julian Hopkins the National Coach. The cost is £1.25 for this well planned and well produced book.
